guides.title: Wish-Ender acquisition through Hunter's Remembrance
guides.subject: Wish-Ender
guides.summary: Obtain Hunter's Remembrance, carry its Awoken Memento on the same character, purify three objectives through hidden events in The Shattered Throne, then claim Wish-Ender at Sjur Eido's statue after Vorgeth.
prerequisites: Own access to The Shattered Throne through the Forsaken Pack or the current equivalent entitlement.
Obtain or recover Hunter's Remembrance from Petra Venj or the Quest Archive.
Keep the Awoken Memento on the same character that is progressing the quest and leave room in that character's kinetic weapon inventory.

steps.title: Purify the first memento in Erebus
steps.description: Take the Arc charge from the Dragon/Tower of the Deep roof to the empty-handed statue on the central Ingress roof. Defeat Theratos, Archersbane and then Querim, the Waking.
steps.objective: Defeat the first hidden Taken enemies and confirm the first purification objective advances.
tips: The event can now be summoned even after the normal Erebus encounter is complete.

steps.title: Purify the second memento during the descent
steps.description: Carry the first charge across the Hallowed Ogre rafter room to its statue. In the slowed Thrallway, carry the second charge through the field, turn right after the exit veil, and deposit it to open Eriviks's side room. Defeat Eriviks, the Waking.
steps.objective: Complete both charge deposits and defeat Eriviks.
tips: If a charge is dropped, return to its original pedestal.
Confirm objective progress before crossing the next load transition.

steps.title: Purify the third memento during Vorgeth
steps.description: Complete one four-Mark collection to break Vorgeth's shield, defeat the Fleeting Shade near the exit stairs, carry its charge to the entrance-left statue, and defeat Xavoth, the Waking. Then finish Vorgeth.
steps.objective: Defeat Xavoth and confirm the third purification objective.
tips: Prepare the four Keeper Wizards before starting the timed Mark collection.

steps.title: Claim Wish-Ender
steps.description: After Vorgeth, interact with Sjur Eido's statue while all three quest objectives show purified. Follow the live quest prompt, including a return to Petra if requested.
steps.objective: Present the purified mementos and receive Wish-Ender.
tips: If there is no valid interaction, verify that this character owns both the quest and its Awoken Memento.

warnings: Older guides describing three separate Dreaming Tokens and a Tangled Shore mission document a retired quest flow.
Trust the current quest objective names and progress returned for the player's character when they differ from an old guide.
factual_claims: Hunter's Remembrance is the current quest route associated with Wish-Ender.
The three purification events are tied to Querim, Eriviks, and Xavoth inside The Shattered Throne.
Sjur Eido's statue after Vorgeth is the quest hand-in location.

guides.summary: Progress the quest on the character carrying the Awoken Memento by completing the Querim, Eriviks, and Xavoth purification objectives in The Shattered Throne, then present them at Sjur Eido's statue.
prerequisites: The quest and Awoken Memento must be on the character completing the dungeon objectives.

steps.description: Deposit the Erebus rooftop Arc charge at the central statue and defeat Theratos and Querim.

steps.title: Eriviks purification
steps.description: Complete the linked charge carries in the rafter room and slowed Thrallway, enter the opened side room, and defeat Eriviks.

steps.title: Xavoth purification
steps.description: During Vorgeth, break the shield, defeat the Fleeting Shade, deposit its charge at the entrance-left statue, defeat Xavoth, then finish Vorgeth.

steps.title: Present the mementos
steps.description: Interact with Sjur Eido's statue after Vorgeth and follow the current quest prompt.

guides.title: The Shattered Throne practical walkthrough
guides.subject: The Shattered Throne
guides.summary: Traverse Erebus by following its changing symbol route, cross the Descent, defeat Vorgeth by collecting four Petitioner marks and extinguishing a sigil, then defeat Dul Incaru using Finite Thought from her three Knights.
prerequisites: One to three players; the activity has no matchmaking.

encounters.name: Erebus
mechanics: Defeat each Architect group, read the symbol it reveals, and travel to the structure carrying that symbol.
When the diving-bird symbol appears, return to the starting Ingress structure and clear it to open the descent.
failure_conditions: A full fireteam wipe resets the current darkness-zone encounter.
Following a memorized symbol sequence can send the team to the wrong structure because the order changes.
tips: Call the symbol before moving and clear long-range Taken threats before exposed crossings.

encounters.name: The Descent
mechanics: Cross the sniper bridge, Ogre rafter room, slowed Thrallway, and Taken launch-trap wall.
failure_conditions: Ogre blasts and launch traps can knock players from narrow paths.
Normal sprint, jumping mobility, and health recovery are restricted in the slowed Thrallway.
tips: Move between broad safe landings, clear Ogres before crossing their firing lanes, and use direct healing in the Thrallway.

encounters.name: Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger
mechanics: Weaken and defeat four Keeper Wizards, collecting their timed Petitioner marks.
The fourth mark becomes Petitioner’s Burden; use it at a central sigil to lower Vorgeth's shield and begin damage.
failure_conditions: The Mark timer expiring kills its holder.
A carrier death loses the active collection.
If Vorgeth survives, the shield and Keeper cycle return.
tips: Clear minor enemies and weaken all four Keepers before collecting the first Mark.
Destroy Vorgeth's tracking darts during damage.

encounters.name: Dul Incaru, the Eternal Return
mechanics: Defeat the three Fatesmith Knights and collect their Finite Thought orbs to damage Dul Incaru.
Destroy crystals when they protect the Knights.
Cleanse Finite Thought at the center brazier before its timer expires.
failure_conditions: Expired Finite Thought kills its holder.
Uncontrolled Taken Psions multiply and overrun the arena.
Fatesmith Knights can return after a cycle.
tips: Clear Psions first, weaken the Knights together, then collect all three orbs for a stronger damage phase.

warnings: Loot tiers, featured status, and weekly farming rules are volatile and require live knowledge.
factual_claims: Erebus uses a changing symbol route.
Vorgeth damage requires Petitioner’s Burden.
Finite Thought enables damage to Dul Incaru and must be cleansed before expiry.

guides.title: Vorgeth encounter mechanics
guides.subject: Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger
guides.summary: Prepare all four Keeper Wizards, collect four timed Petitioner marks, extinguish one central sigil with Petitioner’s Burden, and damage Vorgeth while controlling tracking darts.

encounters.name: Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger
mechanics: Four Keeper Wizard kills and pickups create Petitioner’s Burden.
Extinguishing a sigil removes Vorgeth's shield for damage.
failure_conditions: The timed Mark expires or the carrier dies.
Vorgeth survives and the cycle resets.
tips: Weaken every Keeper before the first pickup.
Use pillars for cover and shoot tracking darts.

factual_claims: Four timed marks are required before a sigil can be extinguished.

sources.title: The Shattered Throne Dungeon Guide
factual_claims: Mechanic cycle and failure recovery.

guides.title: Dul Incaru encounter mechanics
guides.subject: Dul Incaru, the Eternal Return
guides.summary: Control multiplying Psions, weaken and defeat all three Fatesmith Knights, collect Finite Thought for boss damage, and cleanse the timed buff at the center brazier if Dul Incaru survives.

encounters.name: Dul Incaru, the Eternal Return
mechanics: Knight orbs grant stacking Finite Thought, enabling boss damage.
Dul Incaru's crystals protect the Knights and must be destroyed.
The center brazier cleanses Finite Thought.
tips: Clear Psions, weaken all Knights, then collect three orbs together.

factual_claims: Finite Thought is both the damage-enabling buff and a lethal timer if not cleansed.

guides.title: Wish-Ender catalyst acquisition
guides.subject: Wish-Ender Catalyst
guides.summary: For an eligible Wish-Ender owner, the catalyst can drop randomly from The Shattered Throne's final encounter. It is not guaranteed; Bungie fixed a final-encounter drop issue in Update 9.7.0.1.

steps.title: Complete the final encounter
steps.description: Defeat Dul Incaru in The Shattered Throne for a chance at the catalyst.
tips: A completion does not guarantee the drop.

reward.name: Wish-Ender Catalyst
reward.unlock_requirement: Defeat targets with Wish-Ender after the catalyst drops.

warnings: Drop chance and farming rules may change; the guide provider does not claim a drop rate.
factual_claims: The catalyst is associated with the dungeon's final encounter and is not guaranteed.
